member.name: M:OutSystems.NssFileMetadataStripping.IssFileMetadataStripping.MssStripFileMetadata(System.Byte[],OutSystems.NssFileMetadataStripping.RCFileMetadataResultRecord@)
member.summary: Strips metadata from a file. Supports images (EXIF/IPTC/XMP), PDFs, OOXML (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX), and audio/video (MP3/WAV/FLAC/OGG/MP4/MKV/AVI). Unrecognised formats returned unchanged with IsPassthrough=true.
member.param: The uploaded file in any supported format: images (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, etc.), PDF, Office documents (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX), or audio/video (MP3, WAV, MP4, etc.).
The stripped file and audit metadata. CleanFile is safe to forward to AI APIs. ExtractedMetadata contains the removed entries as JSON. RemovedEntryCount and IsPassthrough support audit logging.
